_readme: Single source for the en/ site root (nav, SEO, catalog, sitemap). Human-readable fields are translation units tracked in i18n/ledger.json. Rebuild with: SITE_ROOT=en node scripts/build_nav.js

site.title: Immich self-hosted photo library guide
site.subtitle: Keep your memories at home
site.description: 12-chapter Immich self-hosted photo library guide: login, upload, timeline, albums, AI search, sharing, mobile app, admin, security and troubleshooting.
site.footerMeta: Screenshots are from the official Immich interface. Immich is a trademark of its owner; this site is not affiliated with it.

chapters.title: Before you start
chapters.card: First get clear on what Immich does, what a self-hosted photo library is worth, and the security boundaries around accounts and what is public.
chapters.description: Planning before you start with an Immich self-hosted photo library: what self-hosting is worth, account roles, what is public and security boundaries.

chapters.title: Login and accounts
chapters.card: Open the web UI and log in, then get to know the admin account and your account details.
chapters.description: Immich login guide: open the web UI, log in, then get to know the admin account and your account details.

chapters.title: First open
chapters.card: Get to know the four main areas — Timeline, Albums, Search and Admin — plus the avatar menu.
chapters.description: First tour of the Immich web UI: Timeline, Albums, Search, Admin and the avatar menu.

chapters.title: Upload photos and videos
chapters.card: Drag-and-drop upload, upload status, duplicate detection and retrying failures.
chapters.description: Immich upload guide: drag-and-drop upload, upload status, duplicate detection and handling failures.

chapters.title: Timeline and browsing
chapters.card: Make sense of time grouping in the timeline, the viewer and the info panel.
chapters.description: Immich timeline guide: time grouping, the viewer, the info panel and browsing tips.

chapters.title: Album management
chapters.card: Create albums, add photos, mark photos as favorites and sort them.
chapters.description: Immich albums guide: create an album, add photos, mark photos as favorites and keep things organized.

chapters.title: Search and AI
chapters.card: Semantic search, face recognition, people and tags.
chapters.description: Immich AI features guide: semantic search, face recognition, people and smart tags.

chapters.title: Share albums

chapters.description: Immich sharing guide: shared links, permission settings and keeping public albums safe.

chapters.description: Immich mobile app guide: install it, connect to your server, and turn on automatic and background backup.

chapters.title: Admin settings

chapters.description: Immich admin settings: users, storage, background jobs and capacity management.

chapters.title: Security and minimal exposure
